charts.title: cellcell-compete-movie
charts.caption: Animated GIF of the 20-tick competition run (cadence 1, all 20 ticks captured -- the P1-c refactor fixed a choppy 10-frame cadence-2 bake): two CPM cells, each drawn as a translucent footprint fill + contour (not contour-only, which vanishes once a cell fills most of the frame) in a distinct lineage color, over a Δ-glucose depletion panel (glucose minus its t=0 snapshot on a diverging colormap) rather than the raw field -- a raw glucose panel in this regime goes uniformly dark as both competitors draw it down together, so the winner used to read as an empty dead field; the delta panel is where "who's winning" actually becomes legible. The higher-glucose_vmax competitor (id 1) claims an ever-larger share of the shared lattice while the lower-vmax competitor (id 2) is pushed toward a vestigial fragment of its starting footprint. Re-baked directly via `meta_modelers_guide.cpm.viz.run_colony_frames` + `frames_to_gif` over the same 20-tick run cited in this study's behavior tests, for provenance.

charts.title: cellcell-compete-metrics
charts.caption: Interactive Plotly panel of the same 20-tick competition run, synced to the GIF's time axis: both competitors' biomass PLUS the study's headline number -- the biomass divergence (id 1 / id 2 ratio) -- as its own bold trace on a secondary axis, previously never plotted anywhere (the compete GIF had no metrics panel at all before this refactor). Ends at the same 3.69x final margin (237.9 vs 64.5 biomass) cited in this study's behavior tests. Re-baked directly via `meta_modelers_guide.cpm.viz.metrics_panel` over the same run as the GIF, for provenance. Interactive: hover for exact per-tick values.

charts.title: cellcell-crossfeed-movie
charts.caption: Animated GIF of the 20-tick cross-feeding run: a glucose-to-acetate secretor (id 1, seeded inside the localized glucose depot) and an acetate-consuming cell (id 2, seeded outside it) sharing one glucose+acetate field pair. The consumer's footprint never touches the glucose depot but is visibly reached by the secretor's expanding acetate plume as the run progresses. Re-baked directly via `meta_modelers_guide.cpm.viz.run_colony_frames` + `frames_to_gif` over the same 20-tick run cited in this study's behavior tests, for provenance.

charts.title: cellcell-crossfeed-metrics
charts.caption: Interactive Plotly per-cell time-series panel of the same 20-tick cross-feeding run, synced to the GIF's time axis: biomass, volume, local_glucose, and local_acetate for both the secretor (id 1) and the consumer (id 2). The consumer's local_glucose stays flat at 0.0 the entire run while its local_acetate and biomass both rise, back-loaded to the last several ticks once the plume arrives -- the cross-feeding handoff made directly visible. Re-baked directly via `meta_modelers_guide.cpm.viz.metrics_panel` over the same run as the GIF, for provenance. Interactive: hover for exact per-tick, per-cell values.
